title: DeepSeek's AI Repo Hit 80,000 Stars in One Day #Shorts
description:
DeepSeek's open-source agent runtime crossed 80,000 GitHub stars in about a day. Its central design is that the model, tools, sandbox, approval policy, session log, and agent loop are replaceable plugins.

Watch the full repository breakdown: https://youtu.be/toRw72Gg2ok

Repository: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
